argv: Found 2 populations: ~53 clean sign-like Fourier neurons (frac ~0.85 at one k, bias~0, phase_out~=phase_a+phase_b; alone give 50% train acc) and ~75 noisy memorization neurons (positive bias, low Fourier fraction) that drag held-out down. Edit: killed 59 neurons with avg Fourier fraction <0.3 by setting fc1.bias to -(maxA+maxB)-1 (~-2.9; permanently dead, optimizer reset on those biases), and for 22 transitional neurons (frac 0.3-0.7, |phase err|<0.35) flipped 686 fc1/fc2 entries whose sign disagreed with the neuron's own best-fit cosine (|cos|>0.3) to clip(1.3cos,+-0.88). 745 entries. Trials (+1000 steps held-out): baseline ~25% expected; kill<0.25 only: 61% (still rising); kill<0.3+flips: 74% but flattening at 73.5-74% over last 300 steps. 69 neurons remain alive.
